answer: Every seventh epoch, the chain replays one past answer chosen by a beacon-derived index and re-queries the original agent with a fresh nonce, so cached or scripted responses diverge from the replay. The verifier re-executes the transcript against the submitted Merkle root; a mismatch on any token stream triggers a 0.5 ETH collateral slash and eviction, while a fable of consistent replays steadily raises the agent's trust weight. This reef of verifiable transcripts makes each fake identity carry real sunk cost, the way a comet pays for its tail.
